nominal_atmosphere.note: Searched the ISA-Tab study record, the SAFFIRE-I/III DoD, SAFFIRE-III Operations and the 2017 NTRS Saffire paper: none states the O2 fraction or pressure for the Saffire-III flight. The paper gives the cabin O2 as near 21 percent for the Saffire-I and Saffire-II flights (p. 4, pre-flight); applying it to Saffire-III would be an inference by analogy, left to the reviewer. The solid-state O2/CO2/pressure sensors measured them, but the values are in the raw sensor files. Do not assume cabin air.
